zh: 新登录页：打开 App 先看到新的登录页，上面有「通过 Apple 登录」「使用 Google 账号登录」「使用邮箱登录」三个入口，目前只是占位，还不能登录。内测账号仍用底部的「使用内部测试邀请码」登录。
聊天：Lio 的每条回答下面多一行「由 AI 生成，可能有误，重要信息请自行确认。」；长按 Lio 的开场白又可以复制。
「出示卡」成为「工具」里独立的一张卡（常用语和求助，给对方看），新增商务常用语（报价、起订量、交期、样品、付款方式），以及「商务」区：会面卡、出示地址、一键打车（有打车时显示）；本地协助卡片上的说明文字不再被截断。
路书：模板路书页新增「用作我的行程」（从「工具」和「这趟旅行」首页进入路书都有），用作之后会出现在「这趟旅行」首页的日程里；英文界面下，模板行程显示英文地点名。
「我的」→「设置与账号」新增「隐私摘要」：几句话说明 App 收集什么、发到哪里，完整政策见 https://go2china.space/privacy 。
打开酒店、城际交通、打车、景点预约、点餐时，会自动预填本机已有的资料（不上传）。
行程里每个地点都有打车、给司机看、导航、预约四个按钮。
国籍按账号保存，换账号不会读到上一个人的；落地打车直达「我的酒店」；结束旅行后，准备清单的进度清零。
「这趟旅行」里已保存行程的日期标签改为换行排列：调大系统字号时不再需要横向滑动，行程里的图标也随字号放大。
en: New sign-in screen: the app now opens on it, with Sign in with Apple, Sign in with Google and Sign in with email. These three are placeholders for now and cannot sign you in. Testers still sign in with Use an internal test invitation code at the bottom.
Chat: each Lio answer is followed by a line saying it is AI-generated and may be wrong, so double-check anything important. Long-pressing Lio's opening message copies it again.

Show Cards is now its own card in Tools (phrases and help cards to show to others), with new business phrases (quotes, minimum order, lead time, samples, payment terms) and a Business area: a meeting card, show an address, and one-tap taxi (shown when Taxi is available); the text on the Local Support cards is no longer cut off.

Roadbook: template roadbooks have Use as my trip (from Tools and from the This trip home alike); once used, the trip appears in the schedule on This trip. In English, template trips show English place names.
Me > Settings and account has a new Privacy summary: a few lines on what the app collects and where it goes; the full policy is at https://go2china.space/privacy .
When you open Hotels, Intercity Travel, Taxi, Sight Bookings or Menu Helper, details already on this device are filled in for you (nothing is uploaded).
Every place in a trip has four buttons: taxi, show the driver, navigate and book.
Nationality is kept per account, so switching accounts never shows the previous person's; the arrival taxi goes straight to My hotel; ending a trip resets the checklist progress.
On This trip, the date labels of a saved trip now wrap onto lines: with a larger text size nothing scrolls sideways, and the icons in a trip grow with the text.

zh: 构建 58 接续构建 57。登录页换成新界面；其余是上面列出的小改动。
en: Build 58 follows build 57. The sign-in screen is new; the rest is the small changes listed above.

zh: 登录：退出登录后重新打开 App，确认看到新登录页；点三个占位入口，确认不会崩溃或卡住；再点底部的邀请码入口，输入邀请码能正常进入。
聊天：问 Lio 一个问题，确认回答下面有 AI 提示行；长按开场白，确认出现复制菜单。
把系统字号调到最大（含辅助功能字号），看登录页、回答和出示卡里的文字是否被截断。在「路书」打开一条模板路书点「用作我的行程」，回到「这趟旅行」看日程。
遇到问题，请在内部测试群发截图、问题记录和发生时间。
en: Sign-in: sign out and reopen the app, check the new sign-in screen; tap the three placeholders and check nothing crashes or hangs; then tap the invitation code entry at the bottom and enter your code.
Chat: ask Lio a question and check the AI line under the answer; long-press the opening message and check the copy menu appears.

Set the text size to the largest (accessibility sizes included) and check that nothing is cut off on the sign-in screen, in answers or on Show Cards. In Roadbook open a template, tap Use as my trip, and look for it on This trip.
Share a screenshot, the issue record and the time in the internal testing group.

title.en: Known issues and checks to avoid
title.zh: 已知问题和暂不测试内容

zh: 新登录页的 Apple、Google、邮箱三个入口还不能用，请用邀请码登录。
回答下面的反馈入口本版没有开放。本地协助暂不发送求助消息。
隐私政策网页计划 12 月 1 日公开，在此之前「隐私摘要」里的链接可能打不开。
升级前设的旧格式景点提醒，注销账号后可能仍会弹出，只显示景点名和日期，弹出一次后就会消失。
en: The Apple, Google and email entries on the new sign-in screen do not work yet; sign in with the invitation code.
The feedback entry under answers is not open in this build. Local Support does not send help requests yet.
The privacy policy page is planned to go public on December 1; until then the link in the Privacy summary may not open.
Sight reminders set before this update, in the old format, may still fire after account deletion, showing only the sight name and date; they disappear once they have fired.

zh: 本版没有新增要联网的功能，邀请码登录和已有的联网功能不变。
en: This build adds no new feature that requires internet access; invitation code sign-in and the existing online features are unchanged.

zh: 「工具」新增 7 个：回酒店（排第一，打车回酒店、给司机看、出示卡）、落地模式（落地首日清单）、景点预约（15 个景点的预约规则和放票提醒）、点餐（拍菜单看懂每道菜，按忌口和过敏标出，生成中文点单卡）、酒店、城际交通（火车、航班、大巴）、路书（按天离线手册，可导出 PDF）。
附近新增「必需品」：ATM、药房、厕所、行李寄存。地铁图点车站可看周边。
聊天里请 Lio 规划行程，可按天查看并保存。
「行程」改为「这趟旅行」首页：出发前的准备清单、到达后的当天日程；以前的行程在右上角「所有行程」。
订票、订酒店都跳到官方渠道、12306、Trip.com 或 Klook，App 内不下单、不付款。
en: Seven new tools: Back to Hotel (first; taxi back, show the driver, show cards), Arrival Mode (first-day checklist), Sight Bookings (rules and reminders for 15 sights), Menu Helper (photograph a menu, flags for your diet and allergies, an order card in Chinese), Hotels, Intercity Travel (trains, flights, buses) and Roadbook (offline day-by-day book with PDF export).
Nearby adds Essentials: ATMs, pharmacies, toilets, luggage storage. Tap a metro station to see what is around it.
Ask Lio in Chat to plan a trip, then view it by day and save it.
Trips opens on This trip: a checklist before you go, today's schedule once there. Earlier trips are under All trips.
Bookings open the official site, 12306, Trip.com or Klook; nothing is bought in the app.

zh: 构建 57 接续构建 56。以前的行程列表移到「所有行程」。
en: Build 57 follows build 56. The old trip list is now under All trips.

zh: 行程：点「先只做准备」，关掉「还没定日期」选到达日期，再选护照国籍看入境结论；点「去办」进工具再返回。
回酒店：在「酒店」点「设为我的酒店」，再试打车回酒店、给司机看和全屏出示卡。点餐：拍中文菜单，勾忌口，选菜，打开点单卡（约 10–40 秒，每天最多 10 张）。
景点预约：故宫选 7 天内的日期，点「提醒我」并允许通知。城际交通：查上海→北京，点「去 12306 订票」或「去 Trip.com 订票」。路书：打开「北京三日经典路线」，试打车、景点详情、离线保存和导出 PDF。附近：逐类查「必需品」。地铁：广州「体育西路」看周边。
这是这些功能第一次真机联调，遇到问题请在内部测试群发截图、问题记录和发生时间。
en: Trips: tap Just get ready, turn off Dates not decided yet, set an arrival date and passport for the entry result, open a tool with Go and come back.

Back to Hotel: tap Set as my hotel in Hotels, then try Take a taxi back, Show the driver and a full-screen card. Menu Helper: photograph a Chinese menu, tick diet or allergy items, pick dishes, open the order card (10-40 s; 10 menus a day).

Sight Bookings: Palace Museum, a day within 7 days, Remind me. Intercity Travel: Shanghai to Beijing, tap Book on 12306 or Trip.com. Roadbook: Three classic days in Beijing; try a taxi, Place details, Keep offline, Export PDF. Nearby: each Essentials type. Metro: Guangzhou Tiyu Xilu.
First time on real devices: share a screenshot, the issue record and the time in the testing group.

title.en: Known issues and checks to avoid
title.zh: 已知问题和暂不测试内容

zh: 规划行程可能保存失败，请截图反馈。注销账号后，景点预约的提醒仍会弹出，下一版修；可先逐条「取消提醒」。本地协助暂不发送求助消息。
八达岭 12-16 起、其他景点和入境规则 12-25 起只显示官方链接；行程跨过 12-31 或之后入境的，入境结论现在就只显示官方链接。
火车只列部分车次，完整时刻请到 12306。酒店价格为参考价，日期、人数和是否接待外国人请在 Trip.com 确认。
点餐只显示菜单上印清楚的价格；过敏标记按常见做法推断，请向服务员确认。路书补充信息每天最多 60 个地点、5 本路书。会员方案仍是预览，不扣费。
en: Trip plans may fail to save; please send a screenshot. Sight reminders still fire after account deletion; to be fixed in the next build. Cancel them first if needed. Local Support does not send help requests yet.
Badaling from Dec 16, other sights and entry rules from Dec 25 show only official links; for trips past Dec 31 or arriving later, entry already does.
Trains list some departures; see 12306. Hotel prices are reference only; confirm dates, guests and whether foreigners are accepted on Trip.com.
Menu prices show only when clearly printed; allergy flags are typical recipes, so ask staff. Roadbook details: 60 places and 5 books a day. Plans remain a preview.

zh: 酒店、城际交通、路书补充、点餐、车站周边和必需品需要联网，只对已开通的内测账号开放。地点、酒店和火车来自高德，航班来自飞常准；点餐用阿里云百炼的 qwen-vl-ocr 和 qwen3.8-flash，服务端不保存菜单照片。没有推广链接。
en: Hotels, Intercity Travel, roadbook details, Menu Helper, station surroundings and Essentials need internet and an enabled tester account. Places, hotels and trains from AMap, flights from VariFlight; Menu Helper uses Alibaba Cloud Model Studio (qwen-vl-ocr, qwen3.8-flash); our server keeps no menu photos. No promotion links.
